title: A Lánchíd és a korszerű modernizáció (Modernizing a Country)
grammar: Evidential & Modal Particles in Reformist Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say why the Chain Bridge mattered for Buda, Pest and the nobles' privileges.
I can use kétségkívül, nyilvánvalóan and aligha to say how sure I am.
I can name the bridge's designer and the toll that the nobles also had to pay.
I can use eight new words about the bridge and the Danube.
